commits.message: feat(capi): self-hosted Meta Conversions API for /sales funnel (#73)
commits.author: shalomer

panels.title: feat: self-hosted Meta Conversions API for /sales funnel
panels.scene: A shiny new castle with a large banner reading 'Meta Conversions API' is erected in the village square. Villagers go wild, throwing confetti and holding torches while one villager faintly clutches a book titled 'Sales Strategies.' The knight stands calmly in front, adjusting his sword, looking unimpressed.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: The sales will flow like wine! Our businesses are saved!

panels.title: Feature: villagers rejoice about sales
panels.scene: Villagers dance around a fountain shaped like a dollar sign, spraying each other with water. Some have painted faces and are holding glittery signs saying 'Sales!' while the knight stands stoically in the background, arms crossed.

bubbles.speaker: Other villager
bubbles.text: We'll be the wealthiest village! All thanks to the knight!

panels.title: Rumors of a marketing meeting
panels.scene: A worried group of villagers huddles around a giant glowing scroll that reads 'Marketing Meeting Tomorrow!' Some are biting their nails while others clutch their heads in anguish. The knight leans against a lamppost, looking slightly annoyed.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: What if they ask us for more conversions?!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: Just tell them you have none.

panels.title: 3 commits. 1 feature. 0 taxes raised.
panels.scene: Knight sitting on a pile of gold coins, looking exhausted. Villagers are busy building a large statue of the knight holding a laptop, one villager is fitting a crown on it.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: We shall name our firstborn conversion-api!
